"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'This prayer was presented to those before you, and they neglected it. Whoever preserves it will have his reward doubled, and there is no prayer after it until the dawn rises.'"
Guard strictly your prayers, especially the middle prayer, and stand before Allah in devotion. [Surah Al-Baqarah: 238]
"He was asked (peace be upon him): 'Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?' He said: 'Prayer at its appointed time.' [Agreed upon]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me, for whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times."

"When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me... and then ask Allah to grant me the (status of) Waseelah, for it is a rank in Paradise that is reserved for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I will be that servant. Whoever asks for me the Waseelah, my intercession will be granted to him."

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever says, when he hears the call to prayer: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the Waseelah and virtue, and send him to the praised station which You have promised him. My intercession for him will be granted on the Day of Resurrection.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the front row. The muezzin is forgiven for the length of his voice, and whoever hears him, whether human or otherwise, will testify for him, and he will have the reward of anyone who prays with him.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever walks to a prescribed prayer in congregation, it is like a Hajj (Pilgrimage), and whoever walks to a voluntary prayer, it is like a voluntary Umrah.' [Sahih Al-Jami']"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution as commanded and prays as commanded, will have forgiven for him what he has done of deeds.'🌹"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'There will continue to be a people who lag behind from the first row, until Allah causes them to lag behind in the Fire.'"

"Abdullah said: 'I have seen us, and none would skip the prayer except for a hypocrite whose hypocrisy was known, or someone who was sick. And even the sick would walk between two men until they reached the prayer.'"
"Abdullah said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) taught us the Sunnahs of guidance, and among the Sunnahs of guidance is to pray in the mosque where the Adhan is called.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever neglects the Asr prayer, his deeds will become worthless.' [Sahih Al-Bukhari]. The term neglect is agreed upon to mean when a person deliberately ignores it."
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'The foundation of the matter is Islam, its pillar is prayer, and the peak of its ridge is jihad.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution for prayer and completes it well, then walks to the obligatory prayer, and prays it with the people, or in congregation, or in the mosque, Allah will forgive his sins.' [Sahih Muslim]"

The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: You people will see your Lord as you see this full moon, and you will have no trouble in seeing Him, so if you can avoid missing (through sleep or business, etc.) a prayer before sunrise (Fajr) and a prayer before sunset (`Asr) you must do so.
The one who misses the Asr prayer is as if he has lost his family and wealth. [Agreed upon] The two cold prayers refer to the Asr and Fajr prayers.
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever prays the two cold prayers (Fajr and Asr) will enter Paradise.' [Agreed upon]"

"Angels take turns among you, both by night and by day, and they gather for the Fajr and Asr prayers. Then, those who spent the night among you ascend, and their Lord, who knows best about them, asks: 'How did you leave My servants?' They reply: 'We left them while they were praying and came to them while they were praying.'"

"Your Lord, Exalted and Glorious, admires a shepherd on the peak of a mountain, calling for prayer and praying. Allah, Exalted and Glorious, says: 'Look at My servant! He calls for prayer and establishes it, fearing Me. I have forgiven My servant and admitted him to Paradise.'"
The five prayers and the Friday prayer to the next Friday are an expiation for what is between them, as long as one avoids the major sins.

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever purifies himself in his house, then walks to one of the houses of Allah to fulfill an obligation from the obligations of Allah, his two steps will be: one erases a sin and the other raises him in rank.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I not guide you to that by which Allah erases sins and elevates ranks?' They said: 'Indeed, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Perfecting ablution in difficult circumstances, walking in abundance to the mosques, and waiting for prayer after prayer; this is the true bond (of worship).'"

The Messenger (peace be upon him) would pray the Maghrib prayer as soon as the sun had set and disappeared behind the horizon. [Reported by Muslim.]

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said:'Whoever purifies himself in his house, then walks to one of the houses of Allah to fulfill an obligation from the obligations of Allah, his two steps will be: one erases a sin and the other raises him in rank.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I not guide you to that by which Allah erases sins and elevates ranks?' They said: 'Indeed, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Perfecting ablution in difficult circumstances, walking in abundance to the mosques, and waiting for prayer after prayer; this is the true bond (of worship).'"
"He was asked (peace be upon him): 'Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?' He said: 'Prayer at its appointed time.' [Agreed upon]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me, for whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times."

"When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me... and then ask Allah to grant me the (status of) Waseelah, for it is a rank in Paradise that is reserved for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I will be that servant. Whoever asks for me the Waseelah, my intercession will be granted to him."

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever says, when he hears the call to prayer: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the Waseelah and virtue, and send him to the praised station which You have promised him. My intercession for him will be granted on the Day of Resurrection.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the front row. The muezzin is forgiven for the length of his voice, and whoever hears him, whether human or otherwise, will testify for him, and he will have the reward of anyone who prays with him.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever walks to a prescribed prayer in congregation, it is like performing Hajj, and whoever walks to a voluntary prayer, it is like performing a voluntary Umrah.' [Sahih Al-Jami']"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution as commanded and prays as commanded, will have forgiven for him what he has done of deeds.'🌹"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'There will continue to be a people who lag behind from the first row, until Allah causes them to lag behind in the Fire.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) commanded to hasten the Maghrib prayer as soon as its time enters: 'Pray the Maghrib prayer when the sun sets, and hasten it before the appearance of the stars.' [Reported by Al-Tabarani.]"

"Abdullah said: 'I have seen us, and none would skip the prayer except for a hypocrite whose hypocrisy was known, or someone who was sick. And even the sick would walk between two men until they reached the prayer.'"
"Abdullah said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) taught us the Sunnahs of guidance, and among the Sunnahs of guidance is to pray in the mosque where the Adhan is called.'"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'The foundation of the matter is Islam, its pillar is prayer, and the peak of its ridge is jihad.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution for prayer and completes it well, then walks to the obligatory prayer, and prays it with the people, or in congregation, or in the mosque, Allah will forgive his sins.' [Sahih Muslim]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Pray two rak'ahs before Maghrib.' Then he repeated, 'Pray two rak'ahs before Maghrib.' When he said it the third time, he said: 'For whoever wishes,' out of dislike for it to become a Sunnah for the people.' [Reported by Ahmad.]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, the prayer has a beginning and an end.' He then mentioned: 'The first time for Maghrib is when the sun sets, and its last time is when the horizon disappears.' [Reported by Ahmad.]"

Whoever prays the Dhuhr prayer seeks refuge with Allah Almighty from the punishment of Hell, for its time is at the middle of the day after Hell is heated every day.
It is the first prayer that the Prophet (peace be upon him) prayed after his return from the night journey (Isra) and the ascension (Miraj).

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I not guide you to that by which Allah erases sins and elevates ranks?' They said: 'Indeed, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Perfecting ablution in difficult circumstances, walking in abundance to the mosques, and waiting for prayer after prayer; this is the true bond (of worship).'"
"He was asked (peace be upon him): 'Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?' He said: 'Prayer at its appointed time.' [Agreed upon]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me, for whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times."

"When you hear the muezzin , say what he says, then send blessings upon me... and then ask Allah to grant me the (status of) Waseelah, for it is a rank in Paradise that is reserved for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I will be that servant. Whoever asks for me the Waseelah, my intercession will be granted to him."

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever says, when he hears the call to prayer: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the Waseelah and virtue, and send him to the praised station which You have promised him. My intercession for him will be granted on the Day of Resurrection.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the front row. The muezzin is forgiven for the length of his voice, and whoever hears him, whether human or otherwise, will testify for him, and he will have the reward of anyone who prays with him.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever walks to a prescribed prayer in congregation, it is like a Hajj , and whoever walks to a voluntary prayer, it is like a voluntary Umrah.' [Sahih Al-Jami']"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution as commanded and prays as commanded, will have forgiven for him what he has done of deeds.' 🌹"
"📌The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'There will continue to be a people who lag behind from the first row, until Allah causes them to lag behind in the Fire.'"

"Abdullah said: 'I have seen us, and none would skip the prayer except for a hypocrite whose hypocrisy was known, or someone who was sick. And even the sick would walk between two men until they reached the prayer.'"
"Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: 'The first prayer that he (peace be upon him) prayed was the Dhuhr prayer"
"Abdullah said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) taught us the Sunnahs of guidance, and among the Sunnahs of guidance is to pray in the mosque where the Adhan is called.'"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'The foundation of the matter is Islam, its pillar is prayer, and the peak of its ridge is jihad.'"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever performs ablution for prayer and completes it well, then walks to the obligatory prayer, and prays it with the people, or in congregation, or in the mosque, Allah will forgive his sins.' [Sahih Muslim]"
The Prophet (peace be upon him) would, when the cold was severe, pray early, and when the heat was intense, he would delay the prayer. [Reported by Al-Bukhari]

"The Prophet (peace be upon him) would recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and another Surah with it in the first two rak'ahs of the Dhuhr and Asr prayers, and he would sometimes make us hear the verses. He would prolong the first rak'ah. [Agreed upon]"
"Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) reported: 'The Prophet (peace be upon him) would never miss four rak'ahs before Dhuhr.' [Reported by Al-Bukhari]"
"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever maintains four rak'ahs before Dhuhr and four after it, Allah will make him forbidden to the Fire.' [Reported by Al-Tirmidhi]"

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Your Lord, Exalted and Glorious, admires a shepherd on the peak of a mountain, calling for prayer and praying. Allah, Exalted and Glorious, says: 'Look at My servant! He calls for prayer and establishes it, fearing Me. I have forgiven My servant and admitted him to Paradise."
The five prayers and the Friday prayer to the next Friday are an expiation for what is between them, as long as one avoids the major sins.

"The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever purifies himself in his house, then walks to one of the houses of Allah to fulfill an obligation from the obligations of Allah, his two steps will be: one erases a sin and the other raises him in rank.'"
